name: Dandelia
detailed_description:
Soar through the skies in Dandelia, a cozy and atmospheric adventure where you pilot a graceful flying ship above an endless ocean of clouds.

Drift through breathtaking landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and embrace the serenity of the skies. In Dandelia, there are no high scores, no time limits—just you, your ship, and the wind beneath your wings.

🌬 A Soothing Flight Experience

Navigate the skies with intuitive, relaxing controls. Feel the gentle push of the wind as you explore ever-changing cloudscapes.

☁️ A World Above the Clouds

Discover floating islands, mysterious ruins, and remnants of an ancient civilization lost to time. Every journey brings new sights and untold stories.

🎵 A Soundtrack That Breathes With You

Let the music and ambient sounds evolve as you fly, creating a meditative experience tailored to your journey.

🏡 Customize Your Skyship

Collect materials and upgrade your ship with unique designs and functionality, making it a true reflection of your journey.

Dandelia is not about winning—it's about flying, feeling, and getting lost in a dreamlike world.

Are you ready to take flight?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Oculus Rift, Meta Quest via Link, HTC Vive, Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: Requires a VR headset and tracked controllers. Performance may vary based on system configuration and background processes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Oculus Rift S, Meta Quest 2/3 (via Link or Air Link), HTC Vive Pro, Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: Designed for smooth gameplay on high-end VR setups. A well-ventilated play area is recommended for room-scale VR experiences.
